description: Emotional Detox | Slow Sarangi Instrumental | 1.5 Hours of Indian Classical Music to release heavy feelings and let your heart settle.

Some days you carry more than you can name. Let the sarangi carry it for a while. Ninety minutes of slow, deeply expressive bowed sarangi in Raga Kirwani — tender, warm, and unhurried — made to play softly while you breathe, loosen what you've been holding, and let the weight of the day dissolve.
No ads breaking the calm. Just continuous Indian classical music for emotional release and a lighter heart.
Best for: emotional release · a heavy heart · letting go · evening wind-down · quiet healing.
Put it on, breathe out slowly, and let it go. 🌙
suno_prompt: Instrumental only, no vocals, no humming — slow deeply expressive Indian classical sarangi in Raga Kirwani, warm bowed sarangi with long aching meend glides and tender phrasing, sparse and spacious, NO tabla, very gentle ~55 BPM, soft emotional late-evening character that releases heavy feelings, seamless loop.
suno_prompt_note: MAY-GRADE CALM (the retention fix — May cohort 33% AVD vs July 21%: it's the MUSIC). Genuinely calm, zero upbeat/energetic terms. NO tabla, NO tanpura named (Jul-16 ship was 'Sarangi & Tanpura' — deliberately solo to differentiate packaging). Slow ~55 BPM.
